svg.title: Single-cell model development and its bulk and spatial extensions
svg.desc: Original methodological schematic. Glyphs are conceptual, not measured data. Single-cell features combine 18 subtype proportions and CNV-defined candidate malignant epithelial weighted MLH1. Bulk extends the feature framework; spatial data support exploratory transfer.
svg.text: MMR4: fit on 7; evaluate held-out cohort
MMR4 held out by cohort; subtype scores fixed
Schematic glyphs; external evaluation is retrospective. Spatial groups are inferred, and measurement equivalence is unestablished.
